name: scroll-index

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows a section name label beside the tick rail while the article is mid-scroll.

tagline: Tick rail beside an article tracks reading position and scrubs on drag.
summary: A self-scrolling article paired with a vertical rail of ticks, one per heading. The rail marks passed and current sections, names them on hover, and can be dragged or clicked to jump through the text.
appearance: A dark rounded card holds a white-on-black article with headings and grey paragraphs. Down its right edge runs a short vertical rail of thin horizontal ticks of varying width, a moving progress mark, and an occasional small pill naming a section.
behaviour: Scrolling the article moves a marker along the rail and recolours ticks as they are passed. Hovering the rail swells nearby ticks and shows the section name; dragging scrubs the article, then settles on the nearest heading.
demo_content: Sample article 'Building a component library' with sections such as Principles, Tokens, Components and Shipping.
search_phrases: article with section markers on the side
table of contents rail that follows reading
drag a rail to jump through an article
chapter dots next to a long article
use_when: A long article lives in a fixed-height panel and readers need to see where they are and jump between headings.
avoid_when: It measures real headings, so late-loading or animating content can leave ticks misplaced until a resize.
customise: Pass the article as children plus a heading selector, self or window scrolling and a class name; tick size, rail height, snap distance and flash timing are constants in the source.
weight_why: Pointer tracking, resize observing and a requestAnimationFrame loop while ticks settle.

a11y.note: The article region and ticks are focusable, labelled, arrow-key navigable, and reduced motion skips the smooth jump.

issues: The ticks are faint grey on the dark card, so the rail is easy to overlook.
polish_why: Careful rail behaviour and a clean reading layout; the ticks are faint and the demo text is filler.
title: Scroll Index
